# Weeks on Fire

> AI-generated short-film series production hub: Grok Imagine visuals, Minimax Music cues, screenplays, and open prompt archives.

- Live site: https://ford442.github.io/weeks_on_fire/
- Source: https://github.com/ford442/weeks_on_fire
- Full agent brief: https://ford442.github.io/weeks_on_fire/llms-full.txt

## What this is

Weeks on Fire is a personal cinematic experiment combining:
- **Visuals**: stills and frames from Grok Imagine (xAI)
- **Music**: Minimax Music style prompts, lyrics, and cutaway cues
- **Writing**: episode synopses, screenplays, scene breakdowns
- **Hub UI**: React + Vite gallery with production views

## Primary content (crawl these)

### Live app views (SPA; HTML shell also embeds key titles)
- Visual Archive — Production stills, cutaway suggestion prompts, and test ideas — scene, suggestion, test, and character lanes with copy-ready Grok prompts.
- Timeline — Track scene creation, prompt evolution, media links, and status. Export JSON to commit production history.
- Songs — Browse the series soundtrack — Minimax style prompts, lyrics, episode ties, and copy-ready generation notes.
- Daisy Bell — Rubella & Lillith on the flower bicycle into old London — color HD keyframes beside intentional scratchy period film, sequence board, and street sights.
- Suggestions — Every current cutaway, one-panel gag, and scene suggestion — timed segments with copyable Grok Imagine / Gemini Omni prompts.
- Cartoons — Short cartoon seeds from agents — premise, still, optional Grok prompt. Promote winners to Suggestions.
- Characters — Recurring cast and lawn-ensemble roles — including Qing Rao (清饶), the crystal-skull keeper on the Episode 03 Monster Mash lawn.
- Episodes — Loglines, status, and in-app synopses for every episode — read-only home for scripts and scene breakdowns. Timeline stays the editor.
- Crew — Meet the fictional writer, producer, director, and crew behind Weeks on Fire — bios, quotes, and series credits.
